hero.title: Dependable electrical manpower, when you need it.
hero.lead: NC Falcon connects contractors with skilled, evaluated electricians across North & South Carolina — and gives our electricians steady, meaningful work. Relationships first. Response within 24 hours.

why.title: Built from real experience in the field
why.intro: With more than 20 years of electrical experience behind us, we know what a jobsite actually needs. We solve manpower challenges fast — and we stand behind every placement.

cards.title: Fast Response
cards.text: Every inquiry gets a response within 24 hours. When you're short-handed, you can't wait — and you won't have to.

cards.title: Direct to Leadership
cards.text: You talk to the people who own the business, not a call center. Real communication, real accountability.

cards.title: Evaluated Workers
cards.text: Every electrician's experience is evaluated before placement and matched to your project's skill requirements.

cards.title: Flexible Staffing
cards.text: One helper or a full crew, short-term or long-haul. We scale to your project and your schedule.

cards.title: NC & SC Coverage
cards.text: Based in Charlotte, serving the Carolinas — and open to opportunities nationwide, with per diem where it fits.

cards.title: Competitive Pricing
cards.text: Fair rates that keep your project on budget and keep skilled electricians earning a living wage.

staffing.title: Every skill level your job calls for
staffing.lead: From first-day helpers to seasoned foremen, we recruit through referrals, industry connections, and word of mouth — then match the right person to your project.

positions.name: Helpers
positions.description: reliable hands to keep the crew moving

positions.name: Foremen
positions.description: run the crew and keep you on schedule

cta.title: Whichever side you're on, we're ready
cta.contractor_text: Need skilled electricians for your project? Tell us what you need and we'll get the right people on site — fast.
cta.electrician_text: Looking for steady work and professional growth? Apply online, upload your resume, and let's talk opportunities.
